title: A shark in a canal – level 1
paragraphs: A big shark is stuck in a canal in South Korea. The shark is over three meters long. It is in the canal for three weeks now. Local people call the shark Bukangi. Many people go to watch it swim.

Rescuers try to help the shark go back to the sea. They use a big net, but the net hit rocks. Experts say that city lights and noise confuse the shark. It cannot find its way out. Rescuers now hope that the ocean water will help the shark swim home naturally.
Scientists say warmer seawater brings more sharks near the country.

words.d: when you cannot move or get out of
when someone cannot think clearly or understand a situation
when something happens without any help
